name: maintainer-component-audit
description: Read-only maintainer audit of the remaining Clibridge components, followed by a prioritized improvement backlog and validation plan.

inputDefaults.scope: all production components not yet reviewed

assertions.message: The maintainer component audit is read-only; implementation belongs to a later gated workflow.

phases.name: inventory
commands: find src/adapters src/broker src/daemon src/workflows dashboard test -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort

phases.name: review-adapters-broker

recommendedTests: Run the focused adapter and routing tests.

phases.name: review-daemon-dashboard

recommendedTests: Run daemon, console, and redaction tests.

phases.name: review-workflows-tooling

recommendedTests: Run workflow executor, run-state, and CLI tests.

phases.name: review-contribution-release

recommendedTests: Run CI and inspect release authorization boundaries.

phases.name: synthesis

priorities.change: Replace dry-run fixture with evidence-backed follow-up.

deferred: Dry-run fixture is not a repository finding.
mockData.decision: Run the real read-only audit before implementing any improvement.

phases.name: validation-plan

sequence.evidence: Replace with the actual audit result.

acceptanceCriteria: Every implemented priority has a focused regression test.
mockData.nextRun: Run the focused maintainer-component-review workflow for the first P1.
externalGates: Provider availability and credentials must be checked separately.

phases.prompt:
Turn the maintainer synthesis into an executable, ordered validation plan. Use only the evidence below and the actual repository contract. Separate offline commands from live provider checks and external release/auth gates. Do not execute commands, edit files, publish, or request credentials. Every command must be safe to run from {{cwd}} and diagnostics/live checks must disable fallback. Return JSON only.

Synthesis:
{{results.synthesis}}

Remember the repository's normal gate is npm run ci, but add narrower commands when they give better evidence.
